title: MembershipPaused
description: Medlemskab pauset: a membership is on pause for a period. Published by Membership, consumed by Notification (docs/domain/CONTEXT-MAP.md section 5). The message carries the correlation ID in its X-Correlation-ID header, not in the body.

memberId.description: The member whose membership is paused (MemberId). Consumers use it with from to handle the same event only once.

from.description: The first day of the pause period, a date without a time.

to.description: The last day of the pause period, included, a date without a time.
